scope: Candidates 31-40 of frozen P0 manifest; Claude first pass plus coordinator original-source correction; model predictions not inspected
blinding: data/validation/self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs were NOT opened. FRDB snapshot (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) used for arm metadata only (n, sex, AUC, t1/2, formulation comment, annotated form) with pk_cmax_value columns stripped on read. FRDB Cmax was NOT used: all duplicate-dose arms (troxipide 100 mg x2, lomerizine 10 mg x2) mapped by formulation / source / AUC.
method_note: Single AI pass (no subagents), not an independent human verifier. Statuses: verified / verified_with_caveat / ineligible / unverified. IR never inferred from oral route alone. Paywalled sources time-boxed (one-two retrieval attempts each: publisher, Unpaywall, PMC/Europe PMC). Coordinator independently retrieved and visually checked the buclizine full text and corrected an abstract/title-only false exclusion; this AI-assisted review is not independent human validation.
unresolved_issues: Paywalled originals: lazabemide (Dingemanse 1997 BJCP, 5 arms), AVN944 (Hamilton 2009 J Clin Pharmacol), lomerizine frdb_1074 (Ren 2014 J Chromatogr B). Need library retrieval; lazabemide also needs single-dose vs multiple-dose table separation.
Betulinic acid candidate 46397: source drug is bevirimat (FRDB analyte mis-mapping) — candidate identity invalid.
Indole-3-carbinol candidate 8707: all arms are DIM (non-parent product); manifest SMILES is DIM.
E7820 candidate 8587: source population is advanced solid-tumor patients (FRDB HEALTHY label wrong).
PMDA IF matrices: mefruside and troxipide IFs state only '血中' (blood) concentration, not explicitly plasma; coordinator to decide whether acceptable.
Lomerizine PMDA doses are lomerizine hydrochloride (salt) mass; study formulation not stated; FRDB page anchor (#page=29) stale — table on PDF p.32 of current IF.
Troxipide frdb_1252 is fine granules (non-MR, not a tablet); frdb_1251 film-coated tablet — coordinator to decide IR acceptance. Cited PMDA URL 404; Kyorin IF 15th ed. read via packageinsert.jp.
Mefruside cited IF revision _009 is 404; _013 read. Values are from a generic-vs-Baycaron BE table (generic row mapped by AUC/t1/2).
Tecalcet: n=5 normal-metabolizer subgroup excludes 1 CYP2D6 PM (no all-subject mean); table 6.4±1.6 vs text 6.5±2.2; formulation/salt basis unstated.
Buclizine: full text confirms parent plasma Cmax and fasting despite the serum title/abstract, but the clinical dose formulation/release is unstated; remains caveated, not fully eligible.

candidates.name: BUCLIZINE
candidates.source_identity: Sher N, Siddiqui FA, Hasan N, Shafi N, Zubair A, Mirza AZ. Simultaneous determination of antihistamine anti-allergic drugs, cetirizine, domperidone, chlorphenamine maleate, loratadine, meclizine and buclizine in pharmaceutical formulations, human serum and pharmacokinetics application. Anal Methods 2014;6:2704-2714. doi:10.1039/C3AY41698D
candidates.candidate_notes: Title and abstract describe serum assay validation, but the PK application in the original full text explicitly analyzes plasma. Coordinator retrieved and visually checked the 11-page RSC paper archive after the first AI pass.

arms.exact_locator: Sher et al., Anal. Methods 2014, PDF p.4 (printed p.2707) §3.4; PDF p.8 (p.2711) Fig. 11; PDF p.9 (p.2712) Table 9, BZ column
arms.analyte: buclizine (BZ), parent
arms.matrix: plasma: §3.4 explicitly says blood was centrifuged and plasma removed; Fig. 11 and §5.4 explicitly call the PK profile plasma
arms.population: 24 healthy Pakistani male volunteers overall, mean age 22 ± 1.37 years; drug-specific n not stated
arms.fasting_evidence: §3.4: volunteers fasted overnight before 25 mg BZ and for 4 h after dosing
arms.formulation_evidence: §2.1 says buclizine-containing tablets were purchased locally, but §3.4 does not explicitly identify which dosage form was administered or its release properties
arms.dose_evidence: §3.4: BZ and MZ 25 mg orally; Fig. 11 labels buclizine 25 mg
arms.reason: Original full text confirms parent plasma Cmax after a fasted 25 mg oral dose in healthy adult men. Caveat: the administered PK dosage form and immediate-release behavior are not explicitly identified in §3.4; local-market tablets in §2.1 concern materials for assay and cannot prove the clinical dose formulation.
